description.en: Self-hosted index for Plugin Guardkit: runtime monitoring, risk scoring and containment for installed plugins.
description.zh: 插件卫士的自建索引：已安装插件的运行监控、风险评分与一键隔离。

description.en: Watches every installed plugin, scores its runtime risk from fiber state, install scripts, overrides and version exemptions, and lets you contain any plugin or bundle from one panel.
description.zh: 监控每个已安装插件的运行状态，依据 fiber 状态、安装脚本、覆盖项与版本豁免给出风险评分，并支持在同一个面板里隔离任意插件或 bundle。
